test_title: PYST 12: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - Quant (Held On 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: The one-day work of 2 men is equal to the one-day work of 4 women or the one-day work of 8 qualified workers. 10 qualified workers can finish a work in 8 days. If a man, a woman and a qualified worker work in the same order on three different days, the work is finished in _______ days.
solution:
**Given:**

2 men = 4 women = 8 qualified workers

10 qualified workers can finish the work in 8 days

So, one qualified takes 80 days, one men 2/8 × 80 = 20 days and women 4/8 × 80 = 40 

A man, a woman, and a qualified worker are working on alternate days.

**Formula used:**

LCM of 20, 40, and 80 = 80

Work done by a man in 1 day = 4 units (since 80/20 = 4)

Work done by a woman in 1 day = 2 units (since 80/40 = 2)

Work done by a qualified worker in 1 day = 1 unit (since 80/80 =1)

**Calculation:**

Total work done in 3 days (by a man, a woman, and a qualified worker) = 4 + 2 + 1 = 7 units

Now, to complete the entire work (work = 80 units):

⇒ 11 full cycles of 3 days complete the work 7 × 11 = 77 units 

Total days required = 11 × 3 = 33 days, and an additional day of (80-77)/4 as men will come on 12th day =3/4 to complete the remaining work.

**∴ The work is finished in 33 ³/₄ days, that is 135/4 days.**
